name: com.quotemoto/ratefoundry
title: QuoteMoto RateFoundry
description: Read-only California auto insurance estimates, 30/60/15 & SR-22 rules, and comparison checklists.

tools.name: get_ratefoundry_estimate
tools.description: Compute a non-binding California car and auto insurance cost estimate (aseguranza de carro / seguro de auto en California) for one driver and one owned vehicle with RateFoundry from CDI filing-derived data. Supports California ZIP codes, 30/60/15 liability-only or full coverage (comprehensive and collision), and owned-auto SR-22 / DUI scenarios. Ask for the user’s ZIP area, years licensed, marital status, known rating points, term, vehicle year, mileage, use and coverage; physical-damage coverage needs a deductible. Never infer rating points from tickets or eligibility for a discount. Show assumptions, filing provenance and unavailable programs. Non-owner SR-22 questions use get_sr22_info; this tool does not provide non-owner pricing. No VIN, contact information, policy purchase or lead submission.

zip_code.description: California ZIP area explicitly supplied by the user; never use device location or a street address.

years_licensed.description: Years licensed, explicitly supplied; do not derive from age.

points.description: Known carrier rating points; ask when unknown. Do not convert an accident/ticket to a point count.

product.description: Owned personal-auto only. Use get_sr22_info for non-owner guidance.

sr22_required.description: User-disclosed filing requirement. Omission assumes no filing and is disclosed.

good_driver.description: Use only a user-requested discount scenario; never determine eligibility. Omission applies no good-driver discount.

vehicle_year.description: Required for personal_auto; forbidden for named_non_owner.

annual_mileage.description: Required for personal_auto; user-supplied annual miles.

coverage.description: Required for personal_auto. Liability is 30/60/15. Physical damage adds COMP/COLL.

deductible.description: Required only for physical_damage; same COMP/COLL deductible.

tools.name: get_insurance_comparison_checklist
tools.description: Return structured questions for comparing California car insurance quotes and offers (comparar aseguranzas de carro en California) plus example insurer names for a user-selected California city, including SR-22 and high-risk or DUI shopping checklists. Does not provide premiums, ratings, market shares, underwriting eligibility, or verified carrier availability.

city.description: California city explicitly named by the user, such as "San Diego". Do not pass a street address or infer a precise location.

coverage_type.description: Optional comparison topic. An insurance professional must confirm carrier capabilities and eligibility.

tools.name: get_city_insurance_info
tools.description: Return dated, verified California Prop 103 auto rating factors (driving safety record, annual mileage, years licensed — never credit score) and 30/60/15 minimum-coverage guidance for a California city explicitly named by the user (seguro de carro por ciudad en California). No city premium averages, ZIP-price predictions, risk rankings, market shares, or demographic statistics are supplied. It does not use a device location or street address.

city.description: California city explicitly named by the user, such as "San Diego". Do not pass a street address or infer a precise location.

tools.name: get_sr22_info
tools.description: Return educational California SR-22 DMV filing, DUI license reinstatement, non-owner SR-22 without a car (SR-22 sin carro / seguro SR-22 en California), and coverage-type information. Uses current 30/60/15 California minimum-liability guidance and does not provide legal advice or a live quote.

coverage_type.description: Optional coverage type to explain. Omit to return all four reference options.

tools.name: get_quotemoto_quote_link
tools.description: Return a direct link to QuoteMoto’s separate California auto, SR-22, non-owner, or motorcycle insurance quote flow in English or Spanish (cotizar aseguranza de carro en California). Calling this tool does not create a lead, transmit contact information, submit a form, or purchase or change coverage.
